definitions.explanation: The act of changing one's residence or place of business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{引越|ひっこ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I'm planning to move next month.

examples.japanese: {引越|ひっこ}し⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見積|みつ}もり→見積もり：04699_mitsumori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I asked a moving company for an estimate.

examples.japanese: {引越|ひっこ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: I'm busy preparing for the move.

notes:
Can be written as {引っ越|ひっこ}し, {引越|ひっこ}し, or {引越|ひっこし}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {引越|ひっこ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to move)
- {引越|ひっこ}し⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧ (moving company)
- {引越|ひっこ}し⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧ (housewarming gift)
- {引越|ひっこ}し⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (new address, destination)
- {引越|ひっこ}し⟦そば→そば：14329_soba⟧ (soba given to neighbors when moving in)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally, Japanese people give {引越|ひっこ}し⟦そば→そば：14329_soba⟧ (moving soba noodles) to their new neighbors as a greeting. This custom comes from the pun on そば meaning both "noodles" and "nearby."

RELATED VERB:
- ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧ (to move - verb form)
